paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5, with a change of -8.26% compared to the prior close and -14.68% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 28, 2026.

Recent news includes a report from Stock Titan on August 27, 2026, that Fermi Inc. granted its COO, Jacobo Ortiz, a 147,059-share RSU award, with the grant vesting over three years of service. Ortiz now directly holds 5.6M Fermi shares.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a Form 4 on August 27, 2026, and a Form 10-Q on August 14, 2026, which reported a net loss for the second quarter of 2026. Additionally, Fermi Inc. appointed Lee McIntire as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, as disclosed in a Form 8-K filing on August 13, 2026.
